title: The Dispossessed
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
summary: A gifted physicist from a poor, anarchist moon travels to its wealthy, capitalist twin planet to share a breakthrough. Alternating chapters tell of his earlier life at home and of his time as an outsider abroad.
readIf: you like novels that weigh two different ways of living and are happy to be patient with ideas.
skipIf: you want fast action, as this is a slow, discussion-heavy book.

pairings.reason: Another Le Guin story of an outsider trying to understand a foreign society, with a stronger adventure.
A story about building a new community and a new belief, with a much more urgent mood.
A newer, more practical attempt to imagine how a fairer world could actually come about.
